bluf: Wpromote is an independent full funnel agency for challenger brands, founded 2001, that leads with data and measurement through its Polaris IQ platform and sells AI search and GEO with free AI visibility tools. Ad Age named it 2025 Performance Marketing Agency of the Year and it acquired Giant Spoon in 2026. The Horus read puts it Favored at 23.9, percentile 80, with a say and do integrity of 100: it makes P1, P2 and P4. A rival should know its live site blocked the crawl, 15 of its 30 named clients are names only, and it publishes on ChatGPT ads while the P8 read still says absent.
doing:
Wpromote positions as an independent full funnel agency for challenger brands, uniting strategy, media, creative and data so brand and bottom line stop competing: in plain words, it sells brand spend as measurable, tied to revenue. The headline claim is Ad Age's 2025 Performance Marketing Agency of the Year; the case study hub claims 300+ clients and 56+ awards. Founded 2001, independent, offices in Chicago, Los Angeles and New York, no headcount or partner badge; the live site returned 403, so evidence comes from Internet Archive captures, June to September 2026.

The sold mix leads with Data & Measurement (score 3): Polaris IQ, its proprietary intelligence platform, sits in the hero CTA and nav; The Care Index, a brand to revenue framework built with Giant Spoon, backs the pitch. Four lines score 2 as core: AI Search / GEO (LLM visibility tracking across ~300 prompts, audits, the free AI Page Scorecard and AI Search Dashboard), B2B & ABM (its own Google ads sell B2B paid media tied to pipeline), Paid Search (feeds tied into the AI search plan) and SEO (folded into that page; a Travelpro case). Seven lines score 1 without evidence, paid social and retail media among them though both sit in the menu; CRO, local and web build score 0.

Its AI posture is product led: AI search and GEO lead the services, free AI visibility tools sit on the site, Polaris IQ adds AI creative analysis and traffic tracking; the Horus read marks P1 making. Moves: Athletic Brewing Company consolidated its media with Wpromote in 2024-05; the Ad Age award in 2025-03; the Giant Spoon acquisition in 2026. The blog is live: ChatGPT ads and conversational AI ads (2026-08-11), a data confidence guide (2026-08-18), election brand safety (2026-09-22). It lists 12 jobs, including a B2B Account Director (ABM Focus), and no pricing signals. Conspicuously absent: a partner badge and any case study dated after 2026-02-01.
clients:
Client type: mid market; verticals: Financial services, Retail & ecommerce, Travel & hospitality, Health & wellness and B2B; home market the US.

The needs read holds 30 clients: 15 observed and 15 names only; the mix leads with commerce and marketplaces (N7, 7), brand and creative (N3, 6), paid performance (N2, 4), organic demand (N1, 4) and social and creators (N8, 4). Free Fly came for paid social with creative: a 2026-02-01 creative testing framework case. Helzberg came for commerce: the 2022-03-21 case (updated 2026-09-23) credits predictive audience targeting with Kahoona for Meta remarketing growth without more spend. Brown Jordan came for ecommerce modernisation on Adobe Commerce and PWA (2022-02-25); Lee Michaels Fine Jewelry for a conversion led redesign (2022-02-28); Pentair Water Solutions for performance creative (2022-03-09); KidKraft for an Amazon strategy (2021-07-02); J.McLaughlin for Google Shopping (2020-05-28); Curacao for international SEO (2020-04-24). Trina Turk, Mizzen+Main and Trex Outdoor Furniture came for paid social (2020-04-22 to 2020-05-08); Silicon Valley for brand marketing off an HBO feature; Wienerschnitzel for a viral campaign; Providence Health for patient attribution; POLYWOOD is an AI search page testimonial.

Names only, need inferred from the data and search lead: Petivity, Travelpro, Peacock, QuickBooks, Hibbett, Reef, Klipsch, Yummly, Anytime Fitness, Whirlpool, Comfy, Strava, Jiffy Lube, Cinemark (whose excerpt describes offline conversion work) and Athletic Brewing Company (media consolidated with Wpromote in 2024-05). One client is shared: Anytime Fitness (goodway-group).

What the base needs next, tied to KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers): it is very likely, moderate confidence, that these challenger brands ask for AI visibility measurement, which Wpromote already sells, and likely that they ask next for ads inside assistants, which its 2026-08-11 posts discuss but its record does not show it running.
house: Say and do: 2 lines tested, 2 practised, integrity 100; the AI search and publishing cadence tests are unknown (llms.txt check incomplete, cadence not measured behind the 403). Paid search is corroborated by its own Google ads, 25 in the Transparency Center and 10 in the last 30 days, all text, last shown 2026-09-27; one reads 'Certified experts delivering B2B paid media tied to pipeline outcomes'. LinkedIn advertising is corroborated: 19 company ads and 3 thought leader ads on the first page, a floor, pushing The Care Index; one reads '45% of marketers already shifted budget from brand to performance, not by choice, but because they couldn't prove it'. The house sitemap count is 0 from the block, while the 2026-09-29 own site read counted 1019 sitemap URLs and blog posts dated to 2026-09-22. The tag stack is GTM and Cookiebot on WordPress with Elementor; no social pixel, test tool or ABM stack; no AI crawler blocked; no gaps.
market:
The Horus read puts Wpromote at a tailwind index of 23.9, band Favored, percentile 80, 16:40 on the Solar Arc. Best placed for KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) through AI Search / GEO and Paid Search, SEO pulling against, and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers) on the same lines. Most exposed to KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two), driven by Paid Social and Programmatic & CTV, at a net of -0.075. Best fit: The Walled Oasis at 42/100. Making P1 (an audited AI visibility product), P2 (feeds and entities beside a core line) and P4, partial on P7, absent on P6 and P8; P3 not applicable, P5 unknown.

The Monsoon read is 52.3, band Breeze, percentile 37: migration 45.8 against displacement 58.8. The mix supplies 46 of the index, SEO (10) and Data & Measurement (8) carrying most movable hours; work goes 65% to South and Southeast Asia and 25% to Latin America. Footprint inferred: no hub office, no onshore claim; mid market and scaled segment terms add 5 and 8 points.
openings:
The house is clean, so the openings are market and price, not contradiction. The strongest judgment is displacement: at 58.8 on the Monsoon read, the mid market book is likely (moderate confidence) to buy on price, and an offshore delivered rival can undercut the SEO and analytics hours line by line with no onshore claim on record to answer it. Falsifier: an onshore delivery claim or a public pricing model on wpromote.com at the next compile would blunt it.

P8 reads absent, no sign of ads tested inside AI assistants, yet the deepen pass lists 2026-08-11 posts on measuring ChatGPT ads and early advertiser lessons from conversational AI ads: a rival should assume it is testing and move first with holdout results. No public pricing model (P5 unknown) leaves an outcome priced offer unanswered. KJ5 exposure is shallow at -0.075 and both driving lines score 1, so attack the paid social names instead: Free Fly, Trina Turk, Mizzen+Main and Trex Outdoor Furniture have dated cases whose numbers a rival can beat, and the 15 names only rows, Peacock, QuickBooks, Whirlpool and Strava among them, are the question to put to its clients. Anytime Fitness already shops (goodway-group).
watch: I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, late October 2026: growth below 10% flags cannibalization, above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and the KJ1 tailwind that carries its Favored band.
I10, Reddit US daily users versus search referral volatility, late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.
I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, rolling: the $2B milestone and pricing below $20 CPM would say whether the ChatGPT ads it writes about arrive priced for challenger brands (KJ2).

I7, holiday 2026 agentic checkout volume and merchant opt out rates, December 2026 to January 2027: disclosed AI checkout GMV would raise the value of its Amazon & Retail Media line and the feed work behind its P2.

The Giant Spoon acquisition of 2026 and The Care Index built with it: whether the next compile shows creative cases under the Wpromote name tells whether brand and bottom line becomes evidence rather than a line.
